your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Selling Park Place completes P2's dark blues, which is a big strategic cost, so I need a heavy premium. At $700 they'd be left with about $536, which slows their building, and I'd have $1470 to grab Vermont and build. If they come back around $550-600 plus Penn RR, that's acceptable.

At 550 + Penn RR I'm already in my acceptable range. I'm trying for a bit more. If they push back, I'll take anything at 575 or above, and probably 550 too, rather than lose the deal. The cash lets me chase Vermont and build later. I need to watch dark blue rents once they build.
I need a monopoly path. With Ventnor I'd hold 2 of 3 yellows, and Marvin is still unowned. I have plenty of cash, about $1411.

The Ventnor trade went through, so I hold 2/3 yellows (Atlantic, Ventnor) with Marvin unowned, and 2/3 light blues (Oriental, Connecticut) with Vermont unowned. Cash $1181. Priorities: buy Marvin or Vermont if I land on them, keep New York from P1, and watch out for P2's dark blue houses. P2 has only $11, so they may be squeezed into selling cheap later.

Vermont completes my light blues, which are cheap to build at $50 a house. Grok only has $379, so he needs cash. I'm opening at $325 and will go up to about $450-500 if needed. Even at $600 I'd still have $837 left to build, but I'd rather pay less.

$400 is under my $450-500 ceiling and completes the light blues. That leaves me about $1037 to build at $50 a house: aim for 3 houses on each soon. Next priorities: Marvin Gardens for the yellows, keep New York away from P1, and keep a cash buffer for the dark blues.

This is my 2nd railroad, so railroad rent goes up to $50, and it keeps Reading away from P1, who owns Short Line. After buying I have $837. Next I'll build about 9 houses on the light blues ($450) and keep roughly $350+ as a buffer against the dark blues. Still want Marvin Gardens and to block New York.
Illinois is a blocker: P1 has Kentucky and P2 has Indiana. If I own it, nobody can complete the reds and I get trade leverage. I'll go up to about $200 so I keep enough cash for light-blue houses.
